The stationery presentation: ivory paper, the envelope’s emerald in the rule and the headline, gold dust kept to the envelope’s world outside the paper. The sender’s own words are written in a hand they choose — above, Great Vibes.

One message, three hands

The headline and the printed words stay engraved on the stationery. Only the personal writing changes — the same note, in three scripts a sender could pick.

How it will work: each First Class envelope carries two presentations — the Standard (gold dust) and the Stationery (fine paper). The sender picks one per card, writes their own words, and chooses the hand. The paper is one classic ivory for all ten envelopes; each envelope’s own color lives in the rule and the headline.
